name: Suno
verdict: The most fun AI music generator, and Pro at $10 a month ($8 billed yearly) includes commercial use.
pros: Cheap next to other generative tools
cons: Included credits do not roll over
Commercial use still has terms-of-service limits
pricingNote: The pricing page shows the yearly rates ($8 and $24) and says yearly saves $24 on Pro and $72 on Premier, which is the 20% annual discount. Monthly is that saving added back.
